name: method-sandwich-muon

source.method: Looped Models Done Right, Part I

preserved: Independent prelude and coda stacks surround one tied core stack run `passes` times in stack order.

Before every core pass the state becomes exp(-dt*a)*z + dt*(W e) with the fixed prelude output e: per-channel dt = softplus(.), a = exp(.), full W; W = I, a = 1 and dt = 1 at initialization, and no RMSNorm on e.
The recurrent state starts at the prelude output (z_0 = e); fixed depth, full BPTT and terminal CE.
Every physical FFN is a top-2 expert bank without shared experts; the balance loss E*sum(f_i*P_i), averaged over calls and microbatches, has coefficient 0.001.
adaptations: The 1536-wide, 24/6-head, RoPE-base-1e6 paper cells are not reproduced.
Softmax top-k scores replace the paper's sigmoid top-2 scores; the paper's 25 experts of width 2432 become the expert count and width of the geometry note.
The Section 4.1 MoE tables report the random-state Huginn MoE; this recipe is the released input-initialized path (moe_middle_input_injection).

The paper's sequence length 8192 and global batch of 512 sequences, and the reference code's 250,624-token vocabulary, are replaced by Track P2's 4096-token sequences, 256 sequences per update and the 151669-token vocabulary.

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) replaces the paper's AdamW (peak LR swept over 4e-4 to 8e-4, 200 warmup steps, cosine decay, weight decay 0.1) and the reference code's settings (peak LR 6e-4, betas 0.9/0.98, decay to 0.01x, weight decay on every parameter rather than exempting norms, embedding, head and router).
Common normal(init_std) matrices replace the reference truncated-normal init (std 0.02 cut at 3 std, embedding and head std 1/sqrt(d)).
Publicly reconstructible DCLM replaces the original private corpus; the frozen manifest and tokenizer are separate comparison identities.
Common RMSNorm/RoPE/SwiGLU cells, softmax top-k with selected-weight normalization and dropless dispatch.

Track P2's Muon for hidden matrices (AdamW for embedding, head, routers, norms and other 1-D parameters) and independently owned input embedding/output head; no original-paper quality or scaling claim.

Geometry: the prelude/core/coda ratio becomes 2:1:2 (P2-R1x8-C2 instead of the constructor's 2:3:2 P2-R3x8-C2) to give m0's 12 logical layers at P2's width and heads, so 8 of the 12 logical layers are core visits against the paper's 86% (96 of 112 in P8-R12x8-C8); the preserved top-2 banks use 39 experts of width 1728 to meet m0's unique parameters, and 1728 = 4 x 432, so top-2 x 1728 equals m0's active 8 x 432.

Matrix initialization std=.02 and unit norm scales are P2's; seq 4096, 1,048,576 positions per update, the schedule (95-update linear warmup, constant peak, last 20% linear to 0) and the AdamW or Muon settings are Track P2's; the training recipe (objective, depth, aux coefficient, expert LR multiplier) is the constructor's.
